# CV Revamp

> CV Revamp (cvrevamp.info) is an AI-assisted, human-checked career service for professionals in the UAE, the wider GCC and East Africa. It offers a one-time CV rebuild, Job Hunt, a monthly service that prepares tailored application packs for roles the client chooses (the rebuild included), and interview preparation. The client submits every application personally. CV Revamp never logs in to a client's accounts and never asks for passwords.

## Products
- CV Revamp (one-time, $49.99 USD): ATS-ready CV rewrite in a plain and a designed version, LinkedIn optimization guide, 10+ curated job matches, a personalized career strategy report, delivered within 48 hours of the questionnaire.
- Job Hunt ($99.99 USD for one month, not auto-renewing, CV rebuild included): 12 application packs, each with a CV tailored to the role, a matching cover letter written in the client's voice, and a submission brief carrying an honest fit read, the gaps to prepare for, likely interview questions with answers, and exact submission instructions; plus a fit check on any role the client sends, pre-screening forms filled from the client's record, and deadline reminders.
- Job Hunt Pro ($199.99 USD for one month, not auto-renewing, CV rebuild included): 24 packs, a weekly shortlist of roles matched to the client's goals, and one full interview preparation.
- Interview preparation ($49.99 USD per interview, one-time): likely questions with model answers from the client's own record, research on the organisation, and research on the interview panel when the names are known.

## Positions taken
- The client submits every application. No auto-apply, no account access, no passwords held.
- Honest fit reads: a pack says plainly when a role is below the client's level or when a requirement is not met.
- Guarantee: a pack that misses is rebuilt free without using a slot; unused slots are refunded on request at the batch price divided by the number of slots.
